description: A three-voice stereo chorus whose delay lines feed back, so it runs from a gentle widening through to a long diffuse wash; each voice can be switched to an allpass diffuser

params.text: Sets how fast the three delay times are swept, 0.01Hz at one end of the travel to 0.8Hz at the other
Attenuverts the rate CV before it is added to the rate knob
Sets how far the delay times are swept, from none to 8ms either side of a 12ms base delay
Attenuverts the depth CV before it is added to the depth knob
Sets how long the feedback takes to die away, 0.12 seconds at one end of the travel to 12 seconds at the other, darkening the repeats as it lengthens
Attenuverts the haze CV before it is added to the haze knob
Sets the balance between the untreated signal and the chorus, silence to full wet
Attenuverts the mix CV before it is added to the mix knob
Drives the signal into the delay lines, a fifth to twice its level, with the output level compensated so that only the character changes
Attenuverts the density CV before it is added to the density knob
Sets the level going into the effect, silence to twice
Switches that voice between a swept delay and a four-stage allpass diffuser, and its lamp changes colour to say which
Switches that voice between a swept delay and a four-stage allpass diffuser, and its lamp changes colour to say which
Switches that voice between a swept delay and a four-stage allpass diffuser, and its lamp changes colour to say which

inputs.text: The left signal into the effect
The right signal into the effect; with nothing patched it carries the left signal
Changes the sweep rate, scaled by a tenth and added to the rate knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the sweep depth, scaled by a tenth and added to the depth knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the decay time, scaled by a tenth and added to the haze knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the dry and wet balance, scaled by a tenth and added to the mix knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the drive into the delay lines, scaled by a tenth and added to the density knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to a fifth through twice

outputs.text: The left side of the mix, the wet part soft-clipped through an anti-aliased saturator
The right side of the mix, the wet part soft-clipped through an anti-aliased saturator

notes: the three voices share one sweep, spaced a third of a cycle apart, and the right channel takes those same three sweeps in a different order, which is what makes the effect wide
menu: Haze cutoff @ 0% — a slider setting the corner of the repeat-darkening filter with the haze knob fully anticlockwise, 200Hz to 20000Hz
Haze cutoff @ 100% — a slider setting the corner of the repeat-darkening filter with the haze knob fully clockwise, 200Hz to 20000Hz
Diffuse mode coefficient — a slider from 0.1 to 0.95 setting how strongly the allpass stages scatter a voice switched to diffuse
